sections.subhead: Purchase Orders, Invoicing, and Delivery Status Your Suppliers Can Track Themselves

body.text: A vendor portal is a secure website where your suppliers log in to confirm purchase orders, upload invoices and check payment status. Teknoppy builds custom vendor portals in Kochi that connect to your accounts or ERP. Most go live in 4-10 weeks.

When purchase orders, delivery challans, and invoices are handled through scattered email threads and phone follow-ups, miscommunication is inevitable. Our supplier portals centralize procurement workflows into one transparent, audit-ready dashboard.

sections.h2: What Our Vendor Portal Development Includes

items.title: Supplier Self-Registration & KYC
items.text: Digital onboarding where new suppliers submit company details, GSTIN, PAN, bank accounts, and certificates for administrative approval before receiving orders.

items.title: Purchase Order Management & Delivery
items.text: Suppliers view purchase orders in real time, acknowledge receipt, confirm expected dispatch dates, and generate digital packing slips.

items.title: Invoice Upload & 3-Way Matching
items.text: Vendors upload GST tax invoices directly against issued POs. Integrated approval workflows verify quantities against Goods Received Notes (GRN) to prevent billing disputes.

items.title: Live Payment Status Tracking
items.text: Vendors see real-time payment timelines — invoice received, manager approved, scheduled for payout, and payment processed with bank reference numbers.

items.title: RFQs & Quotation Comparison
items.text: Post Requests for Quotation (RFQs) directly to selected vendors, receive standardized competitive bids, and compare terms side-by-side.

items.title: Many Suppliers & System Integration
items.text: Connect your supplier portal directly to Tally, SAP, Zoho Books, or custom ERP systems via secure REST APIs to keep accounts and inventory synchronized.

items.title: Procurement Mapping (Week 1)
items.text: We map your current procurement lifecycle — from PO issuance and goods receipt to invoice approval and payment release.

items.title: Access & Permission Architecture (Week 2)
items.text: We establish granular role-based access control (RBAC). Each vendor accesses only their own transactions, contracts, and payment history.

items.title: Custom Portal Engineering (Weeks 3–6)
items.text: We develop responsive frontend dashboards and robust backend services tailored to your exact procurement policies.

items.title: ERP & Accounting Synchronization (Weeks 6–8)
items.text: We connect the portal to Tally, Zoho Books, or your enterprise ERP to enable automated bidirectional sync for POs and ledger entries.

items.title: Supplier Rollout & Onboarding (Weeks 8–10)
items.text: We conduct user acceptance testing, pilot the portal with key suppliers, and train your procurement team for full deployment.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for Vendor Portal Development in Kochi

items.html: Strict Data Isolation & Security: Bank account numbers, pricing terms, and GST documents are encrypted at rest and in transit via TLS 1.3, ensuring no supplier can ever view another vendor's commercial data.
Seamless Accounting & ERP Connectivity: We integrate directly with Custom ERP Systems, Tally Prime, and Zoho Books via secure API Integration Services.
Complete Audit Logging: Every action — PO acknowledgement, invoice submission, approval sign-off, and payment update — is logged with timestamped user records for accounting compliance.
Intuitive Mobile-Friendly Interface: Suppliers access orders and upload invoices easily from mobile browsers, eliminating delayed confirmations from vendors on the go.

items.a: A vendor portal is a secure website where suppliers log in to view purchase orders, confirm delivery dates, upload invoices, and check real-time payment status. It replaces scattered email chains and manual phone calls with an organized, audit-ready procurement hub.

items.q: How much does vendor portal development cost in Kochi?
items.a: A core vendor portal with PO confirmation and invoice uploads ranges between ₹1,50,000 and ₹3,50,000. Comprehensive portals with vendor KYC, RFQ management, and bidirectional ERP/Tally integration range from ₹3,50,000 to ₹8,00,000.

items.q: Can new suppliers register and upload GST and bank details themselves?
items.a: Yes. The self-registration module allows prospective vendors to submit company profiles, GSTIN certificates, PAN, and cancelled cheques. Your procurement team reviews and approves documents before granting access to active POs.

items.q: Can suppliers see when their invoices will be paid?
items.a: Yes. Each uploaded invoice displays its current milestone — received, manager approved, payment scheduled, or paid with UTR bank reference details. This dramatically cuts inquiry calls to your accounts department.

items.q: How is a vendor portal different from a customer portal?
items.a: A vendor portal serves suppliers who provide goods and services to your business — focusing on purchase orders, delivery challans, and accounts payable. A customer portal serves clients who purchase from you — focusing on order fulfillment, support, and billing.

items.q: Will the portal integrate with our existing Tally, SAP, or ERP system?
items.a: Yes. We build custom API connectors to sync POs, GRN data, and approved invoices directly with Tally Prime, SAP, Zoho Books, or custom in-house ERP databases, eliminating double data entry.

items.q: How long does a vendor portal project take to launch?
items.a: Core portals typically go live within 4 to 6 weeks. Complex enterprise deployments with multi-tiered approval matrices and deep ERP integrations require 8 to 10 weeks.
